_comment: Ordered fallback chains of CAPABLE free models, tried top to bottom by src/fallbackproxy.js. Ids are FreeLLMAPI catalog ids - check yours with GET http://127.0.0.1:31415/v1/models; an id the gateway does not know is skipped, never fatal. Weak models (flash, flash-lite, mini, nano, small 7-8B) are refused by src/freechains.js. Overrides go in freechains.local.json next to this file. See docs/FREE_PROVIDERS.md.
